programme.title: Melrose Place
programme.desc: Billy hittar Brooke efter att hon försöker begå självmord genom att skära sig i handlederna. Brooke överlever och Billy bestämmer sig för att stanna med henne och sen vara med Alison.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Sydney, störd och förvirrad
programme.desc: När det blir för mycket för Sydney att ta hand om en handikappad Jane, planerar Sydney att flytta Jane till ett ålderdomshem.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Bobby-fällan
programme.desc: När Alycia Barnett återvänder som Bobbys advokat, flirtar Peter med henne i ett försök att investera i Bobbys kabelbolag. Jake tar hand om Jane.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ingen badvakt, del 1 & 2
programme.desc: När Alycia säger till Bobby att han är skyldig 2 miljoner dollar för att driva sitt kabelbolag erbjuder Amanda att hjälpa till. Peter anlitar Sydney som sin dejt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Djävulen i en blöt klänning
programme.desc: Alison och Billy hittar Brooke död i Melroses pool. Billy har svårt att komma över hennes död och hemsöks av hennes spöke.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Konfliktcirkeln
programme.desc: Michael friar till Kimberly igen. Hon får honom att sparka Sydney, men Sydney blir kvitt med en stämning.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Spring Billy, spring
programme.desc: Den allt mer vårdslösa Billy mutar Amanda att dubblera hans lön om han får ett till stort konto, vilket han får genom att stjäla en kampanjidé.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Skoningslösa människor
programme.desc: Alison vägrar sjunka till Billys nivå för att få en ny klient, men hon hoppar i lera, bokstavligen, på en strippklubb för att få den.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den brinnande soffan
programme.desc: Kimberly fortsätter ha bisarra vanföreställningar som Betsy när hon sätter eld på soffan i strandhuset. Så småningom går hon till Peter efter hjälp.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Billys triumf
programme.desc: Billy övergår till tuffa tag under ett affärskonvent när han stjäl avslöjande foton på skådespelerskan Julie Newmar.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Det som åker upp måste komma ner
programme.desc: På Kimberlys begäran tar Peter med Michael på en resa till San Diego. Där följs de båda av en beräknande kvinna vid namn Teri Carson.
programme.sub-title: Det som åker upp måste komma ner

programme.title: Melrose Place: Äkta lögner
programme.desc: Teri Carson anländer i Los Angeles, fast besluten att hämnas på Michael och Peter för hennes dotters förlust i skönhetstävlingen.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Melrose lösgjord
programme.desc: Amanda och Peter försonas äntligen efter att hon ingriper och löser hans juridiska problem med Teri. Michael erkänner sin otrohet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Peters utomordentliga äventyr
programme.desc: Peter befinner sig i ett levande helvete när han anklagas för mordet på Bobby och tillfångatas av schizofrena Kimberly.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Rena rama Betsy
programme.desc: På mentalsjukhuset charmar Peter sköterskan Benson att planera en flykt innan Kimberly/Betsy låter operera honom. Amanda och Michael fortsätter sitt sökande efter Kimberly och Peter.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Dödsdömda systrar
programme.desc: Michael och Amanda utsätter sig för fara när de bryter sig in på Willowbrooks mentalsjukhus för att försöka rädda Peter från Kimberly/Betsy.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Att leva med katastrof
programme.desc: Dagen efter Janes och Sydneys mordförsök på Richard, anmäler Jane honom försvunnen. Men Richard, som faktiskt inte är död, börjar trakassera henne.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Thunderhawk
programme.desc: Walker och Rangers måste hitta en sofistikerad och dödlig ljudlaser efter att den har hamnat i fel händer.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Försenad rättvisa
programme.desc: Trivette måste hjälpa en elev bevisa att hennes fängslade pappa är oskyldig till mord.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Dagen av rening
programme.desc: Walker och Rangers får hjälp av Sammo Law att förebygga ett vit makt-gäng från att orsaka omfattande förstörelse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Svarta drakar
programme.desc: Walker och teamet måste förhindra distributionen av en enorm herointransport på väg till Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hatets soldater
programme.desc: Walker och teamet måste tävla mot klockan för att förhindra ett bråkigt vit makt-gäng från att detonera bomber under ett Dallas-möte.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Generalens återkomst
programme.desc: Walker och teamet måste stoppa ett våldsamt vietnamesiskt gäng som dödade en polis som utredde deras olagliga aktiviteter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kraftmätning på Casa Diablo, del 1
programme.desc: En strid utkämpas mellan Walker och ett par våldsamma bröder som driver en drogkartell.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kraftmätning på Casa Diablo, del 1
programme.desc: Striden fortsätter mellan Walker och de knarklangande bröderna Ortega som har kidnappat Alex och Sydney.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Svensexan
programme.desc: Walkers svensexa, en campinghelg med Trivette och Gage, störs av en grizzlybjörn med smak för människokött och en våldsam brottsling som vill stoppa Rangers från att vittna under hans rättegång.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Bröllopsklockor, del 1
programme.desc: Walker och Alex gifter sig äntligen i en vacker och rörande ceremoni, men först måste de överleva dödliga lönnmördare som hotar deras bröllop och deras liv.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Bröllopsklockor, del 2
programme.desc: Walker och Alex gifter sig äntligen i en vacker och rörande ceremoni, men först måste de överleva dödliga lönnmördare som hotar deras bröllop och deras liv.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: De modigas hem
programme.desc: Nyfödda barn kidnappas från det lokala sjukhuset några minuter efter sin födsel.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Dödlig situation
programme.desc: En lokal polis håller Alex gisslan och Walker måste ta reda på sanningen och avstyra gisslansituationen.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Vit bison
programme.desc: En staty fäller vad som liknar äkta tårar och Walker måste ta reda på varför.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hämndens ängel
programme.desc: När en av Trivettes vänner, en professionell brottare, dör i en mystisk olycka, måste Walker och Trivette hitta mördarna och krossa syndikatet som ligger bakom det.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Förändringens vindar
programme.desc: Walker går in på okänt territorium när en senator ber honom ta en hackare.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lasarus
programme.desc: Federala agenter som jobbar under täckmantel blir lönnmördade. Walker måste spåra det kriminella geniet "The Chairman" som organiserar morden.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Vändpunkt
programme.desc: Texas Rangers har händerna fulla när de jagar efter medarbetare till "The Chairman", det kriminella geniet bakom lönnmorden på federala agenter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Vedergällning
programme.desc: Walker möter äntligen "The Chairman", det kriminella geniet bakom lönnmorden på ett antal federala agenter, men sen Alex blir kidnappad.

programme.title: Trekkies 2
programme.desc: I efterföljaren till "Trekkies" får vi möta Star Trek-fans utanför USA, bland annat en man som kallar sig "Tysklands Spock" och en Londonbo som byggt om sin lägenhet till ett rymdskepp han tänker sälja på eBay för två miljoner dollar.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Simulated Warfare
programme.desc: High technology is changing the modern battlefield. It is also changing training. In this episode, we examine the different types of simulators and other related technology that is being used to help make soldiers more battle-ready.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the National Archeological Museum of Athens
programme.desc: From a dodgy archeologist who discovers a golden mask to an ancient gadget that reveals the future, discover the secrets inside the National Archaeological Museum.
programme.sub-title: Inside the National Archeological Museum of Athens

programme.title: Aircrash Confidential
programme.desc: Terrorists target airliners, exploiting security gaps with bombs in drinks, shoes, and more. Air Crash Confidential explores this cat-and-mouse game with evolving threats and countermeasures like metal detectors, body scanners, and vigilant officers.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 209
programme.desc: Flash flood waters rise as bystanders rush to save a trapped woman from a sinking car. A destructive tornado sweeps through a small town, turning homes and businesses into a pile of wreckage and debris.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Uffizi Gallery, Florence
programme.desc: From a famous artist who vanished to a traitorous Nazi who saved the day, discover the secrets inside the Uffizi Gallery.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Smithsonian Institution, Washington DC
programme.desc: From the Zeros that bombed Pearl Harbor to the rocket that could take humans to Mars, discover the secrets inside the Smithsonian Institution.
programme.sub-title: Inside the Smithsonian Institution, Washington DC

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 6
programme.desc: Learn about the effects of La Niña and how Indian Summer got its name, observe the effects of winter on the planet, and witness the beauy of the halo and the devestation of Hurricane Katrina.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 202
programme.desc: A rain soaked town hits its limit, turning a tiny creek into a raging rapid. A tornado strikes a Florida air show, tearing apart buildings and destroying dreams. Then, a series of massive waves slam into a beach full of unsuspecting spectators.

programme.title: The Spying Game: War in the Shadows
programme.desc: The KGB exploits betrayal in US counterintelligence.

programme.title: My Family and The Galapagos: Episode 1
programme.desc: Biologist broadcaster and conservationist Monty Halls and his family go to the Galapagos Islands, where for the next three months they will experience an utterly unique way of life.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 211
programme.desc: A truck flips on flooded roads, trapping a family in their upside down car. A thrill seeking photographer gets too close to a hurricane. A chaser flips his car in a wild tornado chase. A mudslide sends a truck over a steep incline.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues: Mosquitos
programme.desc: Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa. But even in the Upper Rhine valley, where malaria was still rampant only a century ago

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: Change & Revolution
programme.desc: How does a community form? How does it survive and adapt to change? This episode details the role myths and legends have played in establishing the rules of society and the punishments for those who break them.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 108
programme.desc: Blue skies in Las Vegas quickly give way to monsoon rains that trap a woman in a raging torrent. Plummeting winter temperatures turn Denver roads into a sheet of ice, prompting drivers to jump from their moving cars.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Snipers
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they're a commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train and learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

programme.title: Desert Seas
programme.desc: David Attenborough contrasts the Red Sea with the Gulf, a shallow sister sea more famous for wars and oil. Yet the Gulf is teeming with life and may even help save the wildlife of the Red Sea reef.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: The End of All Things
programme.desc: Death is a frightening, unsettling prospect for us all. Myths and legends help express and explore those anxieties. But they tell us about more than mortal fear alone, for in a culture’s tales of death, we can see what it is they value in life.

programme.title: The Spying Game: Tales of the Cold War
programme.desc: During the Cold War, Germany becomes the battleground for countless spies.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Mountains
programme.desc: This episode shows unique insights into Germany’s mountain world, travelling from Saxonian Switzerland to the Palatinate Forest, from the Harz to the Alps.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Pharoes Head
programme.desc: Egyptian artifacts were stolen from the British Museum. Included: panels from a tomb in Saqqara, an ancient burial ground.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: Miami Sting
programme.desc: The theft of two Peter Paul Rubens paintings and eventual recovery is documented.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Stone Tape Theory
programme.desc: Nick investigates the 6th Precinct in Detroit and the House of Wills in Cleveland.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Shirley Jones
programme.desc: Nearly 40 years after being chased out of a house by "unexplained" experiences, Shirley Jones (The Partridge Family / Oklahoma) revisits her former residence in upstate New York.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Nick is drawn back to Lockport, New York, for a second investigation of the Western Block Company, aiming to further interact with the interdimensional entity he previously encountered on camera.
programme.sub-title: Return to the Haunted Western Block

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Given the house's history steeped in trauma,Bihl Manor is believed to harbor a potent mix of positive and negative energies.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Name
programme.desc: Ryan Buell and company set out on one of their most dangerous cases to date--to help a single mother who is experiencing paranormal activity in a home that was once the site of brutal murders.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Fury
programme.desc: Kathy, her two daughters and her new husband, "Farmer" thought they had the perfect, quiet life deep in the mountains of West Virginia.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: London's Haunted Viaduct Tavern
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane explore the massive gin palaces in the haunted Viaduct Tavern in London.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Kendrick House
programme.desc: Nick visits The Kendrick House and sleeps on a table once used for surgeries to make contact with spirits.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghosts Of War
programme.desc: When Dennis Pongratz finds his deceased father's Army belongings, he unlocks a treasure trove of WWII memorabilia, including an armband removed from a Nazi soldier killed in battle. Soon the Pongratz home becomes a battleground between good and evil.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: Screamville
programme.desc: A man lives in a home haunted by his father's angry spirit. In her new home, an Iraq war veteran hears whispers and is touched while asleep.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kendra Wilkinson
programme.desc: Kendra Wilkinson (The Girls Next Door, Kendra on Top) is desperate to know what or who was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former home in Pasadena, CA.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Chaka Khan, Kristin Bauer, Iqbal Theba
programme.desc: Chaka Khan is saved by a guardian angel; Kristin Bauer comes face to face with the spirit of her father; and Iqbal Theba is terrorized by a demonic spirit.
programme.sub-title: Chaka Khan, Kristin Bauer, Iqbal Theba

programme.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Ranch
programme.desc: PRS saddles up to a remote ranch in Hunt, Texas where black shadows are being spotted and animals harmed. What's more, a mysterious crop circle has formed on the property and the horses refuse to cross it.

programme.title: A Haunting: Black Magic
programme.desc: During the renovation of her 150-year-old Pennsylvania home, Debbie Guy accepts the old house has a ghost and they will have to live with it. But when family members are tormented by an evil entity, Debbie seeks the help of paranormal investigators.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Indiana State Asylum
programme.desc: Nick Groff visits a sanatorium in Indiana and conducts a paranormal investigation.

programme.title: A Haunting: Tunnel Of Death
programme.desc: Candace and John St. Clair explore a haunted tunnel with a gruesome history where slaves were buried alive. Stealthily, an uninvited guest follows them home. Attacked by the entity, they invite paranormal experts to investigate and cleanse the home.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Valerie Harper
programme.desc: Fifty years after her life-altering paranormal experience, Valerie Harper returns to the NYC apartment where she came face to face with the spirit of a woman.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Dark Side
programme.desc: The Wilcott’s 5-year-old son is attacked by an unseen entity. Their only hope is an exorcism.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Get Out of This House
programme.desc: When an aggressive spirit stalks a young family, PRS is called in to investigate. Ryan races to identify and hopefully defeat the entity before it's too late.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Barry Bostwick
programme.desc: Barry and Kim come face to face with the spirit activity that haunts the home forcing Barry to resolve the personal issues that continue to haunt him to this day.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Awakening
programme.desc: Marcy’s son is deployed with the Army. Overcome with worry, a dormant spirits threatens her.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: En gammal vän till Joan dyker upp och tycks röra upp gamla minnen.

programme.title: Doc Martin
programme.desc: Rykten om doktorns "lilla" problem med blod går runt i byn. Peter Cronk är skadad och oron om hans hälsa för Martin och Louisa närmare varandra.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Louisas gamla kärlek, Danny Steel, kommer till Portwenn för att försöka återuppväcka deras romans. Han blir vansinnig på Martin när han blandar sig i hans mammas flytt till ett äldreboende.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 202
programme.desc: När hans mor måste till sjukhuset, behöver Peter Cronk någonstans att bo. Doktorn är inte speciellt förtjust i detta, men Louise är upptagen med sin ansökan till rektorstjänsten.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: Al upptäcker att Bert inte är hans biologiska far; Martin ger diagnosen matförgiftning till en familj vars mor inte mystiskt nog är frånvarande.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: En äldre man som oförklarligt luktar förfärligt söker hjälp hos Dr. Ellingham; den lokala radioprogramledaren, Caroline, verkar ha ett allvarligt alkoholproblem.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 205
programme.desc: Martin undersöker Helen Pratt, men hon kollapsar och dör. Hennes man, Phil, blir arg och tycker att det är Martins fel.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 206
programme.desc: Martins kyliga och komplicerade föräldrar kommer på besök efter sju år, och han har ingen aning om varför.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 207
programme.desc: Mark Mylow planerar att spendera sin svensexa i skogen tillsammans med Al Large, men blir biten av en huggorm. Doktorn har ingen aning om vad de är och hans enda hopp ligger hos skogsvaktaren Stewart.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 208
programme.desc: En medlem ur frälsningsarmén kommer till Portwenn för att försöka hitta en försvunnen kvinna. Danny ber sin motvilliga flickvän Louisa att flytta in med honom.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 301
programme.desc: Martin misstänker att Louisa drabbats av minnesförlust. Joan tvingas behandlas av Martin efter att nästan ha kört på någon.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Bert Large lämnar sin rörmokarfirma för att driva en restaurang. Efter att restaurangen öppnat inträffar flera fall av matförgiftning där Louisa är en av de drabbade.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Ett par och deras son flyttar in bredvid Louisa och orsakar problem för henne, Martin och lokalbefolkningen. Invånarna börjar dessutom upptäcka något ovanligt med PC Penhale.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Fru Wilson, den hypokondriska ägaren av Wilson-hotellet, ger all sin uppmärksamhet till en oberörd Martin, vilket leder till att Louisa blir avundsjuk.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Paulines spelberoende kommer äntligen upp till ytan efter en hetlevrad konfrontation vid mottagningen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: En mystisk andningsinfektion bryter ut i byn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 307

programme.title: On the Case: Snapshot to Murder
programme.desc: A high school student vanishes into thin air during a day studying in the park. Will a photograph from a nearby celebration help solve the case?

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Store
programme.desc: In San Antonio, Texas, video game store manager Amber Belken is murdered in an apparent robbery gone wrong. On further investigation, however, detectives are troubled by the evidence.

programme.title: On the Case: At Death's Door
programme.desc: After a single mother is viciously attacked and left for dead, she still manages to help police track down her assailant.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Hole in their Hearts
programme.desc: A mother of three disappears from her office in broad daylight, and the case remains open for eight years until two farmers unearth a clue.

programme.title: On the Case: Under Suspicion
programme.desc: When a 26 year old wife and mother vanishes, investigators wonder if she simply just ran away or if it was something far more sinister. The search for answers would take nearly a decade and lead her family on a dark journey they could never have imagined.

programme.title: On the Case: No Exit
programme.desc: A young couple, out on the town in Washington D.C., is gunned down in a savage attack. Investigators are at a loss. Would it take another murder to solve the mystery?

programme.title: On the Case: Path of Destruction
programme.desc: When a 14 year old girl is murdered detectives must solve several terrifying crimes before they can bring her killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder by the Numbers?
programme.desc: A small town is outraged when its unofficial mayor is the victim of a vicious attack at work. The police investigation uncovers a number of possible suspects and a confusing trail of evidence but will it lead them to the person who committed the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: The Ultimate Sin
programme.desc: A man's crisis of conscience unravels a decades old mystery behind a young girl's murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Darkness in The Desert
programme.desc: Paula Zahn investigates the story of a Las Vegas starlet who mysteriously vanished during a visit to a local spy store.

programme.title: On the Case: The River's Edge
programme.desc: When seventeen year old high school student Stacey Fairchild disappears from a mall parking lot in Lancaster Ohio, police wonder if she ran away, was kidnapped for ransom or the victim of senseless murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Race To Judgment
programme.desc: A late-night crash claims the lives of four girls. Texas community is torn apart in the search for justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Crossed by Evil
programme.desc: Police race to find a young woman who disappeared on her way to work, but the clues they discover reveal a trail of unspeakable evil.

programme.title: On the Case: A Mystery on Cherry Hill
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman vanishes without a trace, it may take another tragedy before police will be able to solve the mystery of her disappearance.

programme.title: On the Case: Lying in Wait
programme.desc: A young mother goes out for a jog and runs into her killer. Does her teenage daughter hold the clue to solve the case?

programme.title: On the Case: Justice Never Quits
programme.desc: Mary-Jane Marquardt, mother and wife from Chippewa, Wisconsin, was found stabbed to death in her own home. With Mary-Jane's son also missing, the detectives couldn't help but wonder if his disappearance was connected to the murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Warning
programme.desc: When a 15-year-old girl vanishes in the middle of the night, a friend's terrifying secret may be the key to solving the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Turn
programme.desc: A devoted mother vanishes on her way home from work. Her disappearance sends police into the darkest corners of the state and our justice system.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Up In the Air
programme.desc: After her husband's acrimonious departure from Buffalo, Kelly has a confrontation that decides whether she, too, will quit. Jeremy makes a mistake that could end his Buffalo career.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Fire and Ice
programme.desc: When a deadly fire destroys a northern outpost a week before Christmas, Buffalo puts everything aside to come to the rescue. Cargo Manager Kelly receives a shocking diagnosis that renews her fight to quit smoking.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under Pressure
programme.desc: The curse of -40 hits Buffalo pilots Devan and Scott on a food mail flight up the Mackenzie Valley when a mysterious rise in oil pressure threatens to destroy one of the C-46's engines.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: Mikey goes on a treasure hunt to Venezuela for a rare CL-215 waterbomber. Cargo Manager Kelly's stress levels hit a new high when she returns from her Mexican vacation in even worse health than when she left.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The River Lift
programme.desc: A vital ferry link is down, so Buffalo mounts an all-out campaign to airlift 100,000lbs of essential goods across the Mackenzie River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Don't Muck with Chuck
programme.desc: Crusty mechanic Chuck leads the scramble to ready the Electra for a disaster relief mission in Haiti, but fate's curveball sends them to the High Arctic instead.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Finish Line
programme.desc: A multi-stop mission to the Far North has Devan, Scott and Adam facing a series of white- knuckle obstacles.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ski Plane
programme.desc: Young pilots AJ and Andrew get the chance of a lifetime to fly the magnificent DC-3 specially equipped with skis to land on frozen strips.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Buffalo Scores
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North. Cup fever spreads quickly around Buffalo, and for Mikey, what begins as an innocent love for this hockey icon soon becomes an obsession.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Chief Pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck goes one-on-one with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour with the newest member of the McBryan family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Yukon
programme.desc: When thunderstorms and a shaking engine threaten a DC-3 charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dambusters

programme.title: 48 Hours: Stalked: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: A two-part investigation into stalking -- the victims, the stalkers, the dangers and the long-term psychological damage this torment causes. Includes a report on the stalking death of singer Christina Grimmie.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Stalked: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: Some stalkers become obsessed with people they do not know. Includes the story of serial stalker Justin Massler who was arrested for stalking Ivanka Trump, and previously targeted the Kardashian family.

programme.sub-title: NCIS: The Terrorists, The Spies, and The Hackers

programme.title: 48 Hours: Love, Hate & Obsession
programme.desc: In the investigation of the murder of a one-time millionaire, both his ex-wife and his son are suspects.

programme.desc: The case against Jacob Nolan, who claims his cousin and psychiatrist, Dr. Pamela Buchbinder, brainwashed him into attempting to kill her former lover, fellow psychiatrist Dr. Michael Weiss.

programme.desc: Two men convicted for a brutal rape they say they didn’t commit, and DNA evidence backs them up. How did a law professor, her students and new DNA technology play a part in the case?

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in the Mansion

programme.sub-title: All American Murder: The Rise and Fall of Aaron Hernandez

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Brother's Mission
programme.desc: A report on the 2007 death of Karl Hoerig, a decorated military pilot from Ohio and his brother’s mission to track down and bring to justice the accused killer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: Afraid of the Dark

programme.sub-title: Live to Tell: Afraid of the Dark

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Cheese, Cues and Blood
programme.desc: Kelly earns a quick $1,000 at hustling pool to buy a gown for the local Miss Cheese competition, and a suspicious Al is out for blood, mistakenly thinking that Kelly is into prostitution.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Looking for a Desk in All the Wrong Places
programme.desc: While Peggy is away helping Marcy recover her precious childhood belongings that Jefferson auctioned off and gambled away the money, Al, Kelly, and Bud hold an anti-baby meeting and make plans for a new "Bundy World Order.”
programme.sub-title: Looking for a Desk in All the Wrong Places

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck Has a Belly Ache
programme.desc: While Jefferson suffers through a sympathetic pregnancy, Peggy is upset that Al is immune. Even worse Buck is listless and getting all the attention due Peggy.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If I Could See Me Now
programme.desc: Al keeps barely avoiding minor accidents, so Bud and Kelly try to convince him to get glasses, but he keeps insisting that his vision is perfect.
programme.sub-title: If I Could See Me Now

programme.title: Våra värsta år: God's Shoes
programme.desc: After Al falls out of his bedroom window and passes out, he claims he saw God's shoes. He decides to make and sell these shoes in order to make it big.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Kelly Does Hollywood - Pt 1
programme.desc: Al finally gets cable TV installed in the Bundy household, but he cannot find anything good to watch. All that changes when Kelly gets her own talk show “Vital Social Issues N’Stuff with Kelly” on public access TV with just $35 from her girlfriends

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Kelly Does Hollywood - Pt 2
programme.desc: Al, Kelly, and Bud travel to Hollywood after Kelly's talk show becomes a hit with the TV networks.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Al Bundy, Shoe Dick
programme.desc: Al dreams he's a detective on the verge of a big case.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: So This is How Sinatra Felt
programme.desc: Peggy sends Bud and Kelly to spy on Al at the shoe store for the day to confirm her suspicion that Al's recent giddiness is the work of an extramarital affair.
programme.sub-title: So This is How Sinatra Felt

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I Who Have Nothing
programme.desc: Al tries to retrieve his game ball from a former girlfriend after he takes stock of his life and finds he has nothing.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Mystery of Skull Island
programme.desc: As Grandmaster B, Bud does his coolest best while all over a girl who takes him out to non-traditional Bundy things such as rafting and sky diving. Meanwhile, Al and Peggy invite Marcy and Jefferson over to play a new board game called "Ethical Dilemma."

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Just Shoe It
programme.desc: Al is asked to appear in an athletic shoe commercial. Al, being Polk High's 1966 all city running back and shoe salesman, is glad to reclaim his glory days

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Rites of Passage
programme.desc: It's Bud's 18th birthday, but everyone still treats him like a little boy. Does he stay at home for his birthday party with a pony and a clown or does Al have something else in mind for his "adult" son?

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Egg and I
programme.desc: Steve returns to try and reclaim his estranged wife unaware that she has remarried to a younger man.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Psychic Avengers
programme.desc: Al is a broken man after the Bundys can no longer afford to buy a weekly TV Guide. When Jefferson arrives at their house with a fistful of cash, Al discovers that he has been running a psychic phone scam called "Madame Zelda."

programme.title: Våra värsta år: My Dinner with Anthrax
programme.desc: It's Al and Peggy's 20th wedding anniversary, but Peggy only wants one thing from Al....S-E-X. Meanwhile, Kelly and Bud win the "My Dinner With Anthrax" contest which means a house party for the thrash metal band.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: High I.Q.
programme.desc: An invitation to join the high intelligence Alpha club, is issued to Kelly and not Bud. When they discover the real reason behind the gathering, Kelly and Bud decide to handle things with the usual Bundy charm (and violence).

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Teacher Pets
programme.desc: Bud's belief that his 40-year-old teacher is romantic interested in him is greeted by laughter from everyone. But another student smells the smoke and wants the fire for herself.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Goodbye Girl
programme.desc: When Kelly's modeling school closes down, she gets a new job as a greeter at the TV World theme park. When this is threatened by her low performance ratings, Kelly is moved into Commercial Land where she plays "the Verminator" who hunts down roaches.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Gas Station Show
programme.desc: When Al can't pay his bill at the gas station, he is forced to don a uniform and work at the station. He spends the day being hounded by motorists, as well as Peg and the kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 1
programme.desc: Lower Uncton, England 1653-- Seamus McBundy makes the mistake of insulting a witch who casts an evil spell upon the land, shading the town in darkness forever--as long as a male Bundy lives.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 2
programme.desc: The Bundys delight in their comped trip to England, spending here and there. All the while, the town of Upper Uncton conspires to kill the Bundys outside Lower Uncton, so the curse will remain and Upper Uncton can still rake in profits as a tourist town.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 3
programme.desc: The Bundys are cornered by both towns. Upper Uncton wants them dead so they can continue to profit as a tourist trap while Lower Uncton wants them dead so they can end the curse.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Al is shocked about having another kid when Peggy's relatives leave their five-year-old son Seven in the Bundy home.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: T-R-A-Something-Something Spells Tramp
programme.desc: Kelly has to walk through the wilderness after dumping her boyfriend in the forest. Al and Peg try to 'talk' their marriage alive, but without success. Bud dates a girl with the measles.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Every Bundy Has a Birthday
programme.desc: Peggy discovers that Seven does not know when his birthday is, and the family decides to celebrate him... on Al's birthday.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Al on the Rocks
programme.desc: Al has to take a job as a topless bartender to pay for Seven's doctor bill, but Peggy fears that Bud and Kelly might make Seven sick, and kicks them out of the house.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Peggy tries to make Al more interested in having sex with her by purchasing new dresses, unsuccessfully.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Frat Chance
programme.desc: Bud starts his own fraternity to get women.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Chicago Wine Party
programme.desc: The Bundys vote against a two cent beer tax.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Kelly Doesn't Live Here Anymore
programme.desc: Al makes Kelly get a job, so she becomes a waitress.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: Al and the family try to sneak into the first-class lounge by dressing up like rock stars.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Death of a Shoe Salesman
programme.desc: Al buys a cemetery plot so that he will be buried next to a western movie star and a mule. But Peggy feels excluded.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Old College Try
programme.desc: Bud gets a huge money grant to go to college, but Al and Peggy spend it all on items for themselves.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Christmas
programme.desc: Al remembers how the Bundys celebrated Christmas over the years.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Wedding Show
programme.desc: Al becomes frustrated when Peggy can't decide what to wear to a family wedding. Meanwhile, Bud gets to know the bride and Kelly spends time with the bridesmaids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This
programme.desc: Peggy and Marcy ruin Al's fishing trip by constantly fighting. Meanwhile, Jefferson and the kids spend Marcy's money.
programme.sub-title: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Heels on Wheels
programme.desc: Kelly buys a motorcycle, which upsets the rest of the family who find it unsafe.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Party
programme.desc: The whereabouts of a list of enemy agents operating in the United States are locked in the memory of a captured spy, Col. Vanin (guest star Frank Marth), and no one, including the spy, can penetrate his mind in "The Party"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blind
programme.desc: An F.B.I. man is blinded while investigating a crime syndicate attempting to take over a large chemical plant. Jim Phelps undergoes a delicate eye operation so as to appear convincingly blind when he poses as the sightless man.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Encore
programme.desc: William Shatner guest stars as an aging hoodlum who is artificially transplanted back to the 1930s and the scene of his unsolved crime.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Tram
programme.desc: The leaders of two underworld factions call a top-level meeting at a ski resort to set up a financial holding company capable of creating chaos within the national economy.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Mindbend
programme.desc: To help the IMF team break up a crime syndicate that specializes in brainwashing ex-convicts into committing political assassinations, Barney substitutes for a former prisoner looking for an operation to give himself a new appearance.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Shape-Up
programme.desc: Guest stars Gerald S. O'Loughlin and Christopher Stone portray crime syndicate bosses in charge of the waterfront who extort huge sums of money from every ship docking at a west coast port.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Miracle
programme.desc: An undercover agent is murdered while trying to intercept a huge heroin shipment in the Pacific Northwest and the IMF team is called to take over and put the dealer and his chief executioner out of business.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Encounter
programme.desc: Guest star Elizabeth Ashley plays the alcoholic wife of a crime syndicate leader whose involvement in an intimidation racket and the cold-blooded murder of an employee puts the IMF team on his trail.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Underwater
programme.desc: Stolen gems worth seventy-five million dollars scheduled to be fenced to an underworld figure suddenly disappear and the ship on which they were being transported is blown up at sea bringing the IMF team into the picture.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Invasion
programme.desc: Guest star Kevin McCarthy plays the role of a highly-placed Defense Department advisor who has murdered an Air Force official and sold vital top-secret material about America's nuclear defenses to foreign powers.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blues
programme.desc: Barney poses as a prospective rock-music recording artist to get evidence linking an organized crime figurehead played by guest star William Windom to the sudden death of a beautiful recording star who was being blackmailed by the syndicate.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Visitors
programme.desc: Guest star Steve Forrest plays the role of a millionaire publisher and communications tycoon who has sold fifty-one percent of his empire to an underworld crime syndicate which gives them a powerful influence over state politics.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nerves
programme.desc: Christopher George guest stars in the role of a psychotic ex-convict determined to wreak vengeance on society.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Run for the Money
programme.desc: Guest stars Richard Jaeckel and Herbert Edelman play gangsters who try to get control of all the illegal betting parlors in the country as well as a virtual takeover of all thoroughbred horse racing.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Connection
programme.desc: Jim Phelps and his IMF team are given the assignment of breaking an underworld ring attempting to set up one of the world's largest drug manufacturing plants off the coast of Africa.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bride
programme.desc: Casey poses as a young peasant girl from Europe imported to be the bride of Joe Corvin, the top man at getting underworld millions into Swiss banks.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Stone Pillow
programme.desc: Guest star Bradford Dillman plays Edison, a former private detective turned extortionist who is blackmailing a powerful crime chief with a roll of film linking him to murder.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Vad kan vara konstigare än att ett stort hål öppnar sig i Lucy Sherringtons vardagsrumsgolv? Jo, kärleken, som det visar sig.

programme.title: Bel Ami
programme.desc: Georges Duroy (Robert Pattinson) är en hänsynslös charmör som manipulerar sin väg till toppen i 1890-talets Paris, från smutsiga vindskammare till överdådiga salonger.

programme.title: Jexi
programme.desc: Med hjälp av AI-assistenten Jexi i sin nya mobil börjar den ensamme Phil få ett mer socialt liv. Men snart förvandlas Jexis artificiella intelligens till en mardröm som är fast besluten att behålla Phil bara för sig själv.

programme.title: Boys And Girls
programme.desc: Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) och Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunde inte vara mer olika. Som barn stod de inte ut med varandra. Som vuxna är det deras olikheter som knyter dem samman i den här roliga romantiska komedin från regissören till SHE'S ALL THAT.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush är baserad på Bill Keenans bästsäljande självbiografi med samma namn. Filmens Bobby Sanders flyttar från Harvards hockeylag till div. 1 i Sverige, i en deal som inbegriper en tvättmaskin och torktumlare.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: Benjamin
programme.desc: I Simon Amstells gripande, bittersöta komedi, kastas en ung, framstående filmskapare in i emotionell turbulens av en spirande romans och den kommande premiären av hans andra långfilm.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: När Abigail, en singelmorsa med två små barn, träffar Ben på en bar så hittar de skämtsamt på saker till en lista med sådant som de måste göra innan de gör slut på sin låtsasrelation, hela tiden fullt medvetna om att det ändå aldrig kommer att bli de två.

programme.title: Barefoot

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera

programme.sub-title: It Isn't the Fall That Kills You

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing

programme.desc: Cliff hjälper sin flickvän att ändra på sitt yttre men ångrar sig genast när alla möjliga killar börjar stöta på henne, till och med Sam.

programme.title: Cheers: Christmas Cheers
programme.desc: Julafton blir inte en höjdare på Cheers efter att Sam sticker iväg för att leta present till Rebecca, Rebecca ser till att alla måste jobba sent och Norms jultomtekompisar samlas för att fira slutet av säsongen.

programme.title: Cheers: Woody for Hire Meets Norman of the Apes
programme.desc: Woody försöker övertyga sina vänner om att han har fått en roll i en TV serie.
programme.sub-title: Woody for Hire Meets Norman of the Apes

programme.title: Cheers: And God Created Woodman
programme.desc: Woody tar på sig skulden för en vas som Rebecca förstörde under personalfesten och det slutar med att han blir kompis med högsta chefen.

programme.title: Cheers: Tale of Two Cuties
programme.desc: Annie Tortelli täcker för Carla på Cheers och Drake får Rebecca avis när han anlitar en väldigt attraktiv ung kvinna.

programme.title: Cheers: Yacht of Fools
programme.desc: Rebecca tror sig ha chans på Evan Drake då hon och hennes vän Sam blir inbjudna till hans yacht.

programme.title: Cheers: To All the Girls I've Loved Before
programme.desc: Frasiers svensexa blir inte så lyckad som det var tänkt och Liliths möhippa hamnar nästan i lågor.
programme.sub-title: To All the Girls I've Loved Before

programme.title: Cheers: Let Sleeping Drakes Lie
programme.desc: Rebecca ser på när Norm målar om Evan Drakes sovrum men åker fast när Evan plötsligt kommer hem utan förvarning.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.
programme.sub-title: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Julein Thevenet Case
programme.desc: On January 27th 2014, in Somme-Suippe in the Marne, Sophie Thevenet discovers her dead husband's body in the garage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Émilie Godest Case
programme.desc: On November 9th 2007, around 11:30PM, aid arrives on the scene of an accident at the exit of Chateney-en-France.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.desc: On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood.
programme.sub-title: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente, are called to a fire in a large house in the village. They arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, Claude Tavernier, 83, lying in a large pool of blood.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.
programme.sub-title: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school
programme.sub-title: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.
programme.sub-title: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.
programme.sub-title: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.
programme.sub-title: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell Case
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains. Taken to hospital, the couple die several days apart. The food poisoning theory is quickly ruled out and forensic tests show the Labrells were poisoned with arsenic.
programme.sub-title: The Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.
programme.sub-title: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 205
programme.desc: Vi möter Dianne, som opererat bort sina bröst på grund av cancer, och lever ensam eftersom hon skäms. Motorcykelentusiasten Anette åkte utomlands för att fettsuga magen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: Två av landets bästa plastkirurger hjälper människor som varit med om misslyckade operationer. Möt Pia, som efter en bröstförstoring fick stafylokocker och blodförgiftning.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 104
programme.desc: Två av Danmarks toppkirurger hjälper offer för misslyckad plastikkirurgi. Vi möter bland andra Pernille, som får en kick av att plastikoperera sig, men vars armar är fulla av stora ärr.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 309
programme.desc: Vi möter Ditte, som har spenderad 120.000 kr. på en bröstförstoring och står nu med stora men asymetriska bröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 804
programme.desc: Vid 15 års ålder bestämmer sig Caroline för att hon vill spendera sina besparingar på nya bröst så snart hon fyller 18 år. Men hennes högra bröst börjar hänga och brösten ser annorlunda ut.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark
programme.desc: För 25 år sedan var Susanne med om en våldsam trafikolycka som gjorde hennes ansikte vanställt. Sedan olyckan har hon genomgått mer än tio operationer, men tycker fortfarande att hon ser ut som ett monster.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 202
programme.desc: Misslyckade plastikoperationer ger ärr på både kropp och själ. I detta program möter vi bland annat Linda som mår så dåligt över ärren på sin mage att det går ut över hennes arbete.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 402
programme.desc: Vi möter Maja, som skäms så mycket över sina silikonbröst att hon håller resultatet hemligt för sin man.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 405
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Jette, som har valt att inte amma sina tre barn på grund av sina silikonbröst, och Charlotte, som fortfarande har köttsår på insidan av låret efter en fettsugning.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 403
programme.desc: Vi möter Charlotte som skäms över sina silikonbröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 903
programme.desc: Nanna har genomgått flera bröstoperationer och korrigeringar, men har nu kvar missformade, hårda bröst. Heidi kan inte stå ut med att se sig själv eller andra nakna på grund av operationerna.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 401
programme.desc: Vi möter Christina, en perfektionist som efter två kejsarsnitt har ett fult ärr och en bula på magen, som hon experimenterar med att dölja genom att svepa in magen i plastfilm.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 805
programme.desc: Som tonåring har Linette en sned septum i näsan som orsakar andningsproblem. När hon är 21 år erbjuds hon en näsoperation för att rätta till problemet, men får en krokig näsa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 106
programme.desc: Vi möter fyra personer som har genomgått plastikkirurgi med förödande konsekvenser, däribland Lone, som lever i rädsla för att hennes implantat är cancerframkallande.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: Vi möter Connie, som ville ha naturliga bröst men blev rekommenderad av sin kirurg att välja de största implantaten.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Idag möter vi Dorthe, som har så svårt att släppa taget om sitt gamla jag att hon har kvar sina infekterade implantat. Michela skäms över sina bröst och gömmer sig i stora luvtröjor.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: Vi möter Melissa som ångrar sin operation djupt, och Helle, som täcker sig efter sin operation på armarna. Samtidigt är Lenes högsta önskan att kunna göra något bra för sig själv.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 902
programme.desc: Efter en bröstoperation har Samantha tunga, smärtsamma bröst och ett förhållande som är i gungning. Allan har senare uttryckt sin oenighet med Samanthas förklaring till varför förhållandet tog slut.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Misslyckad plastikkirurgi har lämnat tre patienter med ärr på både kropp och själ. Nu är två av landets skickligaste plastikkirurger redo att erbjuda sin hjälp igen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Misslyckade plastikoperationer ger kvinnor ärr på både kropp och själ. Vi möter Sasja som har gjort en bröstförminskning, men nu känner att hon måste dölja sina bröst som är olika stora.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Pitter Patter of Wedding Bells!
programme.desc: Marnie och Casey välkomnar ett tillskott till familjen. Samtidigt nalkas en annan stor dag, och alla är på Ibiza inför Hollys bröllopsdag. Är det kärlek i luften för alla, eller kommer den senaste tiden händelser att överskugga dagen?
programme.sub-title: The Pitter Patter of Wedding Bells!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Back on the Toon
programme.desc: Gänget är tillbaka i Newcastle för en utekväll på stan! Vilka kommer att dyka upp efter alla bråk? Blir det en natt att minnas av rätt eller fel skäl?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Reunion Finale
programme.desc: Det är dags för en sista fest i 'Geordie Shore'-huset som avslutning på återträffen. Gänget ska ta farväl av varandra. Skiljs de åt som vänner, eller finns det fortfarande problem som måste åtgärdas?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordiegänget är tillbaka!
programme.desc: Geordiegänget är tillbaka! Marnie Simpson planerar sitt drömbröllop, medan Charlotte Crosby, Holly Hagan och Sophie Kasaei träffas och pratar om graviditet, föräldraskap och nya pojkvänner. Sophie vill veta om hon är en av Marnies tärnor.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Den stora dagen!
programme.desc: Marnie Simpson och Casey Johnson blir ett! Men dagen är inte helt perfekt. Hon, Nathan och Chloe pratar ut som sina problem med Charlotte. Men vad händer när alla träffas på familjebröllopsresan till Cypern?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Grundregler
programme.desc: Charlotte och hennes kille Jake har det jobbigt med röran och oljudet i villan, och när Marnie får veta att Jake har pratat om deras son Rox blir det otrevligt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Mammor i krig!
programme.desc: Gänget drar på zoo för en familjedag, men det slutar i katastrof. Röran i villan blir för mycket för vissa, och det leder till ett omskakande gräl.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Stanna eller åka?
programme.desc: Gänget är chockade efter Charlottes och Jakes uttåg, och undrar om de kommer tillbaka eller r borta för gott. På en utekväll i Paphos hettar det till mellan Ricci och Abbie

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Mammor till undsättning
programme.desc: Gänget får veta om Charlotte tänker komma tillbaka eller inte. Chloe tar kontakt med sitt ex Sam Gowland och vill ha en ursäkt för hur deras turbulenta förhållande slutade.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Drabbad av exet
programme.desc: Gänget ska ha en stor utekväll, men det spårar snart ur när Sophies lojalitet i bråket mellan Charlotte och Marnie ifrågasätts. Sam Gowland går med på att komma till Cypern och träffa Chloe.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Kaos och avslut
programme.desc: Efter tre år träffas Chloe och Sam för första gången efter sin separation. Abbies mormor och Chloes mamma kommer till Cypern och är redo att skapa kaos på egen hand.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tillbaka till The Toon
programme.desc: Innan gänget åker hem blir de mållösa när James ger dem ett chockerande besked. Charlotte och Nathan ses för första gången sen en berusad Nathan sa vad han tyckte om Charlotte på Marnies bröllop.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: En nystart
programme.desc: Holly åker till sjukhuset för sitt kejsarsnitt medan resten av gänget ska gå ut på stan för att fira av James. Men vilka dyker upp efter allt tjafs på Cypern?

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyles bestman James och geordiegrabbarna kommer till Ko Samui för Kyles svensexa men Nathan och tjejerna har släppt loss i Bangkok. Holly dyker upp men Sophie känner sig nere och de andra spekulerar i om det är på grund av osämjan med Marnie.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Efter en vild utekväll i Bangkok är Nathan och Chloe överens om att det är dags att dra till Ko Samui, där Holly är ensam tjej omgiven av sina ex. Familjen ser fram emot att återförenas men det blir jobbigt för Ricci när Chantelle kommer till huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyle och James konfronterar Jay och Ricci om varför de inte kom till Kyles förlovningsfest. Jay blir överrumplad och det uppstår spänningar. Och gänget kan inte fatta att Marnie dyker upp på svensexan, speciellt inte Sophie... Superjobbigt!

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Marnie och Sophie rensar luften och det blir spänt. Det anländer fler personer till huset, och Ricci kan inte fatta att Chantelle har sagt att det som hände mellan dem inte betydde något - de kysstes ju bara när de var fulla.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Ricci konfronterar Chantelle om att hon sagt att deras fling inte betydde någott. Det tar skruv! Hans goda avsikter slår också fel när han försöker förklara för James Leah att Jays fräcka kommentarer var oskyldiga... Chockerande!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Drunk Punch Love
programme.desc: Ronnie och JWoww sluter fred vilket leder till att Sammi ger Ronnie ett knytnävslag i ansiktet. Vinny träffar en tjej med en högdragen familj. Och Mike får reda på Deenas lilla fula hemlighet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Should We Just Break Up?

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: It was meant to be a temporary exhibit, a demonstration of French engineering acumen at the Paris World's Fair; but to Parisians, the tower, designed by the brash, young Gustave Eiffel, came to stand for much more.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: From the Pharos of Alexandria to modern automated buoys, lighthouse history features personal stories of keepers, daring construction, and optical discoveries; today these structures become inns and retreats as navigation advances.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: For centuries, banks enable the creation of wealth; a chronicle of banking, from its early European origins to e-banking; modern technology revolutionizes the way banks do business.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Around the world and across the eons, gold stands as a symbol of power, wealth, and love; the story of the hunters of the precious metal and their methods for extracting it.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Begun in 1817, the Erie Canal was an engineering wonder of 363 miles of water highway linking the western frontier to the Atlantic seaboard; it took eight years to construct and thousands of hours of brutal labor.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: During the 19th century, transcontinental railroads link California to the East.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: An exploration of the Nazi construction called the Atlantic Wall - 3,000 miles of shore fortifications along occupied European coastline; the episode highlights the logistics of construction, types of fortifications.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The Pentagon, completed in 1943, serves as the five-sided nerve center for the nation's armed services and stands as the largest office building in the world, conjuring an imposing image of American military power.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: When the men and women aboard a modern submarine hear the command to dive, they can take a measure of comfort in the fact that no US sub has been lost in nearly 40 years, though it's been said that the sea is a more hostile environment than space.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Hurricane Katrina devastated New Orleans, submerging 80% underwater due to levee and pumping system failures; investigate engineering causes behind Superdome nightmare, major escape route design flaws, and Louisiana coastline sinking issues.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The Mighty Mac connects the pastoral northern mainland of Michigan with the state's heavily forested Upper Peninsula and stands as a testament to the dreams, determination, and hard work of a small few who created a true masterpiece.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Satellites and the Global Positioning System spark a revolution in cartography.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The history of one of Thomas Edison's first inventions, the phonograph; rare photographs and recordings document Edison's race against Alexander Graham Bell.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: When poliomyelitis swept the nation, thousands died or became disabled before American ingenuity and desperation led to one of history's greatest scientific breakthroughs; witness how polio shaped FDR's vision and made Jonas Salk famous.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Advancements in rescue technology, including the Jaws of Life and a Searchcam system that locates buried victims.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Bees do it; chemists do it; even Photocopiers do it; if it's not done enough, the world will become unglued - literally; from Velcro hooks to Gecko feet, making things that stick is no easy task.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The past, present and future of insulation technology.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: From ancient solutions to the development of modern water and sewer services, plumbing helped to make civilization possible.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Cutting, digging, picking, stripping, shaking, and raking--whatever the crop, there's a custom machine to harvest it; it all began with handpicking, and today it's often one man and one machine harvesting hundreds of acres in a single day.
